sub: Ethan's house · Prof. Oak's Lab · Pikachu

items.text: Ethan's house: a Potion waits in the bedroom PC (Item Storage, Withdraw). Mom is downstairs. Leave by the left doormat tile only (bug 1).
Prof. Oak's Lab: Pikachu (L5) as the starter. Later the parcel from Viridian gets the Pokédex and 5 Poké Balls.
The sign lady stands in the corridor north after the lab and clears it only once the START menu has been opened and the map re-entered.
